evidence_summary: Direct GitHub issue observed open with zero comments and no assignee.
Advertised bounty is USD 65 with ETA 24 hours.
Acceptance surface is bounded to proving the current module files are tidy and adding an early CI guard that fails with a diff when they are not.
payload.recommended_test: On an isolated clean Sounding worktree, prove go mod tidy leaves current go.mod and go.sum byte-identical, then add the smallest CI step before go test and verify both clean and intentionally untidy cases.
